lesson.meaning: A formal request for information, or an official investigation into something.
examples: I need to make an inquiry about the status of my visa application.
Please submit an inquiry through our online portal if you have any technical issues.
During the board meeting, a shareholder raised an inquiry about the company's financial performance.
The police have launched an official inquiry into the cause of the accident.
I received an email inquiry from a potential client asking for our service brochure.
lesson.memory_tip: Remember, when you have an 'inquiry', you are usually asking 'in' depth for 'information' or starting an 'investigation'.
